messages:
Priyanka Rao: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for gen-api edge behaviors (streaming/truncation/token limits/retries). Need a prioritized acceptance criteria list and a concrete enumeration of edge cases customers hit.
Jordan Lee: I'll paste the list of customer issues we've seen last quarter.
Sam Ortiz: reminder: keep acceptance criteria measurable (latency, accuracy regression, idempotency) :+1:
Anya Kapoor: also need rollout gates for canary + fallback to sync generation.
Rui Chen: infra-bot reports 3 deploys failed last week due to retry storms.
infra-bot: [alert] retry-thundering detected in prod cluster us-west-2 at 03:12 UTC
Priyanka Rao: Proposed acceptance criteria:
- Streaming: resume token semantics documented; clients can resume from last ACK within 60s and receive identical suffix when model doesn't hallucinate.
- Truncation: contract specifies deterministic truncated token marker and a non-empty 'truncated' flag in response when cutoff happened.
- Token limits: API returns 413-style error with remaining token budget and recommended safe prompt size.
- Retries: server ensures idempotent resume via resume_id + idempotency window 120s; retried streams must not double-deliver tokens.
Jordan Lee: Edge-case enumeration (raw list):
1) client disconnect mid-stream then reconnects after cache eviction
2) partial KV-cache mismatch across versions
3) resumed request hits a different model quantized variant -> non-deterministic suffix
4) retry storms from mobile SDK with aggressive backoff misconfigs
5) prompt+suffix total token overflow during parallel retries
6) stop-sequence triggered in first stream but subsequent retry omits it
7) streaming with function-calls and truncated JSON payload
8) streaming with embedded embeddings causing token miscount
Sam Ortiz: For each case we should specify severity, repro, acceptance criteria, workaround, and rollout mitigation.
Anya Kapoor: Prioritization suggestion:
- P0: client disconnect + resume semantics (1,3)
- P1: truncation explicit flag and client guidance (2,6)
- P2: token-limit error metadata + SDK helpers (5,8)
- P3: retry-thundering mitigations + server-side circuit breakers (4)
Rui Chen: Implementation notes from infra:
- Maintain per-request resume_id stored in fast KV for 5 minutes.
- If model variant differs on resume, return 409 with deterministic fallback (re-run from scratch on pinned variant) instead of mixing outputs.
- Add server-side rate limiter per issuing API key for stream open attempts to mitigate storms.
Priyanka Rao: Acceptance test checklist drafts:
- unit tests: resume_id persisted, resume response matches suffix for deterministic model
- integration: simulate reconnects across model variants -> verify 409 path
- e2e: mobile SDK with flaky network -> verify at-most-once delivery inside 120s window
- perf: measure median extra-latency introduced by resume path < 30ms 95th
Jordan Lee: UX/API changes to surface:
- streaming responses include headers: X-Resume-ID, X-Truncated: true/false, X-Remaining-Tokens
- error body for token-limit: { 'code':'token_limit_exceeded', 'allowed_remaining': 1024 }
Sam Ortiz: SDK TODOs:
- expose ResumeStream(resume_id) helper
- automatic exponential backoff with jitter and max_attempts
- helper to parse truncated payloads and surface clear error for function-calls
Anya Kapoor: Rollout plan:
- spec + PRD this week
- small canary in Dedicated with 5% traffic next week
- enable server-side limiter + metrics dashboards before broad rollout
- docs + SDKs released on day 0
Rui Chen: Metrics to track post-launch:
- resume_success_rate
- duplicate_token_rate
- avg_resume_latency
- token_limit_error_rate
Priyanka Rao: OK can everyone review the draft acceptance criteria/edge list by EOD tomorrow? I'll collate and convert into the PRD checklist after comments.
Jordan Lee: will do.
Sam Ortiz: ping me if you want me to write the SDK bits.
Anya Kapoor: leaving detailed repro steps in a follow-up thread.
Rui Chen: I'll open infra tickets for KV retention + rate limiter.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-2145 for resume KV retention
Priyanka Rao: thanks all — will update thread with PRD link when ready.
